channels.note: rt/lowcmd: every motor of the balance loop (35 slots, hg LowCmd_). Usually not written by a user controller while the robot walks: keep it enforced anyway.

rt/arm_sdk (G1 weight slot 29 = kNotUsedJoint). The blend weight moves at most 0.02 per frame and 0.5 /s; it leaves 0 only where rt/lowstate (observed) says the arms are, or by 0.02 until the targets were stable for 50 frames. The SDK example g1_arm7_sdk_dds_example sets the weight to 1 at once from the measured pose: for it set max_weight_step 1.0 and max_weight_rate_per_s 1000 (the rt/lowstate check then gates the hand-over).

rt/api/sport/request (G1 locomotion client, ids 7xxx). SetVelocity limited and its duration capped at 1 s; every SetFsmId refused unless listed (500 = Start, 0 = ZeroTorque, 1 = Damp, 2 = Squat, 3 = Sit, 4 = StandUp): list 500 if this controller starts the walking controller; queries pass.

Dex3 left hand: mode octets must be the SDK's (motor id = index, status 1, timeout 0/1); frames passed unchanged or suppressed. The firewall channel is balance_critical false (a hand may be released).
rt/api/arm/request (G1 arm actions): ExecuteAction 7106, ExecuteCustomAction 7108 and StopCustomAction 7113 refused unless listed; GetActionList passes.
